selection.rule: For each original-normalization input bin, select the lowest global seed ID then lowest original stratum with a recorded pair; fail preparation if any bin is empty. Keep the actual 3D source state, not a median or interpolated state.

paid_review: not requested; routine local audit under AGENTS.md
claim_boundary: Qualify direct first-return state/time and event-corrected 2D derivatives at the declared observed states. This is not an invariant-curve or scalar critical-point test, branch-count certificate, symbolic-letter assignment, chain-arrow verification or homoclinic claim. No endpoint extrapolation or changed EXP-482 verdict. All cases, bins, missing returns and failed comparisons must be reported.
